P14-23.name: The TrueGuardian Doubleburn
P14-23.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Unsheathe] (When Summoned)
You can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card that can brave with this Spirit from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[When Braved] [LV2][LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
If this Spirit is braved with an "Exalted Sword" family Brave, once per turn, this Spirit refreshes.

P14-03.name: Leaf Blager
P14-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Ultimate.
[Rush: Red]
(While you have a Red symbol, the following effect activate next)
[Red Core]: Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

P14-06.name: Roller-Golem
P14-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's LV.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While you control any Ultimate, when your Spirit with [Crush] is destroyed by the opponent, discard a number of cards from the opposing decktop equal to the destroyed Spirit's cost.

P14-X01.name: Shining-Pentan-Overray
P14-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
All your "Pentan"-named Spirits can brave with up to a total of two Red/Purple/Yellow Braves.

[LV3]
All your "Pentan"-named Spirits gain +3000 BP.

P14-X05.name: The DarknessGuide Rutile
P14-X05.effect:
When Spirits with [Rush] you control are destroyed by the opponent, return this Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If your Life is three or less, you can summon an "Exalted Sword" family Brave card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

P14-X06.name: The LightGuide Lapis
P14-X06.effect:
When Spirits with [Charge] you control are destroyed by the opponent, return this Spirit card from the Trash to your Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When your Life is three or less, you can summon a "Fencer" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.
